meta.title: Kora OS | About Kora
meta.description: Learn how Kora connects the people, customers, products, services, payments and everyday operations behind modern businesses.

about.headline: Built to make running a business simpler.
about.intro: Kora is a business platform designed to bring the everyday parts of running a business together in one connected place.
about.storyTitle: A clearer way to run the everyday.
about.operations: From staff and customers to appointments, walk-ins, services, products, payments and performance, Kora helps business owners and their teams stay organised, work efficiently and understand what is happening across their business.
about.fragmentation: Many businesses still depend on a mix of notebooks, spreadsheets, messaging apps, separate payment records and disconnected tools. Kora brings these activities together, giving businesses a clearer way to manage their operations and make better decisions.
about.serviceBusinesses: For businesses that serve customers through appointments and walk-ins, Kora provides tools for bookings, queues, staff schedules, service delivery and customer management.
about.productBusinesses: For businesses that sell products, Kora is being built to bring products, transactions, customers and business performance into the same connected experience.
about.marketplace: Kora also creates a bridge between businesses and their customers. Through the Kora Marketplace, customers can discover businesses, explore what they offer and interact with them through a simpler digital experience.
about.scale: Whether a business operates from one location or manages a growing network of branches, Kora is being built to provide greater visibility and control.

connected.title: The essentials, working together.
connected.body: See the moving parts of your business in one clear operating picture.

about.attribution: Kora is developed by Realtegic Tech Solutions.

meta.title: Kora OS | Our Mission
meta.description: Kora’s mission is to make everyday business operations easier to run, grow and understand through one connected platform.

mission.headline: Make business easier to run, easier to grow and easier to understand.
mission.intro: Our mission is to give businesses a simpler way to manage the people, customers, products, services, payments and everyday activities that keep them moving.
mission.belief: We believe business owners should not need multiple disconnected systems to understand what is happening in their business.
mission.narrative: Kora brings essential operations together so owners and teams can spend less time managing fragmented processes and more time serving customers and growing their businesses.

privacy.metaDescription: Read how Kora handles account, business, customer, commerce, session and operational information.
privacy.title: Kora OS privacy information.
privacy.body: This page describes the categories of information represented in the current Kora platform and the practical ways to raise a privacy enquiry.
privacy.legalTitle: Clear information about the data Kora handles.
privacy.legalIntro: Kora is developed by Realtegic Tech Solutions. The summary below is based on the current product architecture and should not be treated as a substitute for formal legal advice.

information.title: Account information
information.body: Kora may process your email address, display name, verification status and other identity information needed to provide passwordless account access.

business.title: Business and team information
business.body: For Kora for Business, this can include organization, branch, staff profile, role, invitation, availability and service-assignment information.

customer.title: Customer and booking information
customer.body: Customer records, appointment details, queue activity and service history may be processed to help a business serve its customers.

commerce.title: Services, products and transactions
commerce.body: Kora may store service and product records, inventory movements, posted transaction records, receipt summaries, payment records and correction activity. Kora is not a bank or payment processor.

sessions.title: Payment and cash records
sessions.body: The platform distinguishes recorded or disputed payment claims from financially posted transactions. Cash sessions, ledger entries, counted cash and variance are physical-custody records; raw payment-card data is not represented as a Kora account credential in the current architecture.

use.title: How information is used
use.body: Information supports account access, workspace operations, bookings, customer experiences, reporting, access control, auditability and service improvement within the product.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: Records are retained according to their operational purpose, account state and applicable business processes. Kora does not publish a fixed retention period on this implementation page.

rights.title: Access, correction and deletion requests
rights.body: You may contact Kora about accessing or correcting account information, or about a deletion request. Some records may need to be retained where they support business operations, financial history, security or auditability.

security.title: Security and communications
security.body: Kora uses passwordless email OTP authentication, session controls, role-based access, tenant and branch checks, audit events and protected server-side APIs. No unsupported certification or security guarantee is claimed here.

contact.title: Privacy enquiries
contact.body: For privacy questions, contact info@koraafric.com. Include enough context for Kora to understand the account or business involved, but do not send passwords or OTP codes by email.
